SEIB cap: 17 weeks during Pregnancy Leave and 24 weeks during Parental/Adoption Leave 'inclusive of any paid Leave received under Clause 1.2.1', i.e. 24 weeks in all for a birth parent. A cap on two named benefits only, so flagged ambiguous: restriction on c4 and c5 (R20; checklist §5 example 8), not cap_weeks_all_sources; derived employer weeks for the birth parent may exceed the 24 the text allows.

The agreement's Parental/Adoption Leave lengths (35/37 weeks) match the ESA before the Fair Workplaces, Better Jobs Act, 2017 (s. 49(1.1) transition); s. 49(1) in force on 2018-02-26 gives 61/63. Coded as two leaves linked concurrent_with; flagged as a rule gap on c2.

Not components (cannot be used for a birth or are not leave/pay/protection): Compassionate Leave on a death (Income Security cl. 1-2), Court Leave, Elected Public Office Leave, Education Leave, Exchange Leave, Sabbatical Leave, authorized absence (Academic Responsibilities cl. 11: 'not a Leave'), Child Care day-care spaces and Family Care information office, religious rearrangement of duties, Phased Retirement, incarceration leave. The tenure postponements tied to Court Leave and Elected Public Office Leave are likewise not components.

Leave-cycle restriction (two years between successive leaves; no more than 24 months of leave in seven years) excludes Pregnancy and Parental/Adoption Leave, Sick Leave, Compassionate and Court Leave; recorded as a leave_limits entry on c14 and c15 only.

Pregnancy and Parental/Adoption Leave cl. 1.1.1 and 3(d): a Member may postpone the leave by the weeks a newborn or newly-adopted child is hospitalized (within 52 weeks of birth for Pregnancy Leave) and may apply for Compassionate Leave (c13). Cl. 6: the leaves are not a break in service; cl. 8: they count toward sabbatical eligibility; cl. 10: entitlement to modify or postpone a coinciding sabbatical; cl. 5: benefits continue during SEIB; cl. 5.1 vacation accrues.

U8: Members who do not meet the service requirements for Pregnancy/Parental Leave or SEIB are directed to Faculty Relations for other arrangements (Compassionate Leave, Leave of Absence, sick leave, Reduced Workload, Alternative Workload, ESA entitlements); a member with two years of service meets them, so these are notes, not components.
